text:
alyssa: quick heads-up — i'm going to run a small experiment next week to soft-gate ~5% of tenant traffic from v1 -> v2 by sticky-cohort so we can validate metrics without a global flip :eyes:
ben: cool. what's the rollback plan if we see error spikes?
carmen: also need to confirm quota counting — do we count v2 tokens against the same tenant quota or split for the probe?
alyssa: plan A: same quota so billing surfaces stay consistent; plan B if we see billing weirdness is to shadow-count (increment a v2_probe counter but not enforce). open to feedback.
dmitri: telemetry question: we need more granular signals for quality regressions (e.g., hallucination rate proxy + latency p95). can we tag trace with "cohort_probe=true" so dashboards can slice?
alyssa: yep — i'll add a routing_tag and attach route_metadata: {cohort: "soft_probe_v2_2026_03", tagged_by: "alyssa"} in the request envelope.
ben: please include sampling config. ops needs to know if we plan to expand to 20% next month.
alyssa: sample config (will push to infra flag):
```
{
  "probe_name": "soft_probe_v2_2026_03",
  "percent": 5,
  "sticky": true,
  "expand_on_ok": 0,
  "rollback_on_error_rate": 0.02
}
```
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag soft_probe_v2_2026_03 will be enabled in staging at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
carmen: console UX — we should surface an affordance on the tenant page showing "probed: v2 (5%)" with a CTA to opt-out. if they opt-out, we should sticky-exempt them and route to v1 immediately.
nina-ui: can mock — two quick approaches: badge + tooltip, or a modal with more detail. prefer badge for low noise. sample label: "[Beta] v2 probe — 5% of requests".
dmitri: logging requirements: record original_version_hint + routed_version + probe_tag in spans. add a metric counter `routing.probe.v2.requests` with labels tenant_id, status_code, latency_bucket.
enny: (random note) we should be careful with batch/kv-cache effects when mixing versions — sticky cohorts may pollute caches. add a cache-ttl tag or per-model kv namespace to avoid cross-version contamination.
alyssa: good catch @enny — i'll add a per-variant namespace so v2 probe uses kv_namespace=v2_probe_2026_03.
ben: telemetry alert thresholds? propose alerts: error_rate > 1.5x baseline OR latency_p95 > baseline + 120ms for 10m.
dmitri: agreed. also create a debug endpoint to force-route a request for a tenant for testing. CLI: `redwood route force --tenant T123 --to v2 --sticky 1h`.
carmen: UX flow if tenant opts-out via console: immediate sticky removal + a confirmation email + a console banner showing they are opted-out of probe. we should also record opt-out event to kernel for auditing.
alyssa: action items: (1) i will add routing_tag + probe flag to infra (2) @nina-ui will push badge mock by EOD (3) @dmitri will add metrics & alerts (4) @carmen will write console copy for opt-out flow. i'll open the feature flag PR shortly.
ben: and please include a small smoke test that sends 2000 requests and asserts routing distribution ~5% within 1% margin.
alyssa: will do. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ops-bot: feature-flag PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/2345 (labels: soft_probe_v2_2026_03).
dmitri: once merged, i'll wire alerting and dashboard slices (cohort tag). can we get a quick review on the probe metric cardinality? don't want per-tenant high-card metrics.
alyssa: use tenant_cohort label only (low-card), avoid tenant_id on the high-rate metric; keep tenant_id on sampled traces only.
ben: great. schedule a 30m follow-up after 24h of data collection to decide expansion.
alyssa: putting follow-up on calendar for Thu 10:30am PT. thanks all.
